notes.title: Resizable screen and minor fixes
Do you know my creator's new game?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575127/96e4fdcb3e9ffbf93c99a5cb159f775ae3ede807.png[/img] Hi! If you are seeing this, you must know me. But in case you haven't, I'm Brian the Brain. My game was released in June of this year (2021) and recently my creator released a new little game called "Echo - An Indie Tale". https://store.steampowered.com/app/1764970/Echo__An_Indie_Tale/

I don't understand any of that. He doesn't have a protagonist... (or at least not one who has a face) You die all the time... there are rocks falling on your head... anyway...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575127/3fad2466fd1b6d5a6b5e90443a8515bf72706714.png[/img]

But my creator says it's pretty cool (I doubt it's as good as my game) and you can go there on his page to check it out, maybe put it on your Steam wishlist and hope for a promotion.
